name: slab track-bridge interaction
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 板式轨道与桥梁共同受列车作用时的动力联系。
usage_overview: 在移动列车作用下的动力分析中，着重考察轨道板与桥梁通过连接界面传递作用力的过程，以及这种联系对双方振动响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: Besides, by firstly clarifying the degrees of freedom vector of the rail, the track slab and the bridge girder participated in each time step, dynamic matrices characterizing the train-slab track-bridge interaction are truncated with time to reduce the matrix size.

In this paper an improved modelling method for characterizing slab track-bridge interaction subject to a moving train is proposed, where an innovative matrix truncation method is developed to improve the computational efficiency.
